physics-killer-02.title: Usaha lan owah-owahan timbal balik energi mekanik
physics-killer-02.topic: Usaha lan owah-owahan timbal balik energi mekanik
physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-02.material: Saka dhasar rel tanpa gesekan (dhuwur $0$) ana lingkaran vertikal (loop) kanthi jari-jari $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Benda massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ dicopot saka rel supaya ngubengi loop sapisan. Yen $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake dhuwur wiwitan minimum $h_{min}$ (saka dhasar) supaya bisa ngliwati pucuk loop tanpa ninggalake rel, lan gaya normal $N$ sing ditrapake rel ing benda ing pucuk nalika dhuwur wiwitan $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.thinking.0: Usaha lan owah-owahan timbal balik energi mekanik
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Saka dhasar rel tanpa gesekan (dhuwur $0$) ana lingkaran vertikal (loop) kanthi jari-jari $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. Benda massa $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ dicopot saka rel supaya ngubengi loop sapisan. Yen $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, pasangan endi sing bener kanthi urutan nuduhake dhuwur wiwitan minimum $h_{min}$ (saka dhasar) supaya bisa ngliwati pucuk loop tanpa ninggalake rel, lan gaya normal $N$ sing ditrapake rel ing benda ing pucuk nalika dhuwur wiwitan $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Syarat minimum $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Saka kekekalan energi $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Nalika $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Saka $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Yen mung nganggo dhuwur $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ tegese energi kinetik ketinggalan (jawaban salah ①), $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ tegese gravitasi diabaikan (jawaban salah ②), lan $90\,\mathrm{N}$ yaiku kesalahan tandha amarga gravitasi ditambahake (jawaban salah ③).
physics-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-02.s.s1.hint.0: Ing pucuk $mg+N=\dfrac{mv^2}{R}$, syarat supaya ora ninggalake rel yaiku $N\ge0$, yaiku $v_{top}\ge\sqrt{gR}$. Saka kekekalan energi $mgh=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$.
